exposure: integrated management model of pre-pregnancy diabetes using Internet of Things technology combined with typical diagnosis and treatment
cohort: 173 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus at Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: The integrated management model combining the Internet of Things platform with standardized diagnosis and treatment for pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus resulted in improved compliance and patient satisfaction, along with reduced maternal and infant complications.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean sections was significantly lower in the joint management group compared to the traditional management group.
